notes.frame: x to the robot's right, y forward, z up, metres, at the standard size (100%); triangles anticlockwise seen from outside
notes.layout: where each piece goes: robot_models.layout(weapon, size, house, shapes) in the robot window's code (shared-world-demo/robot_models.py), mirrored by the page; size is the standard size the robot is drawn at (lab_sim.shapes' k scales the whole robot after)
notes.nodes: chassis: the body (its pose from the server); deck, skirt_r, skirt_l, rear: the armour panels on their hinges (rw_gfx.RobotVisual.panel); beacon: a Resident Robot's flashing dome; weapon: the weapon (its pose from the server); chain: the chainsaw's chain, run along the bar; wheel0-3: the wheels, spinning about x
notes.roles: colour None: the design's colour; "trim": the style's trim colour; emission "lights": the style's lights colour (screen colour) times 6
notes.shadow: what the sun's shadow map draws of a robot (CHANGE 152): each piece without the roles in skip, and the pieces named here (the wheels: plain tyres) in place of those
